batchRequest.request: Add an optional brake adjustment service and a field for the owner's preferred collection date.

patchOf:
root = Stack([header, form])
header = CardHeader("Bicycle Repair Intake", "Tell us about your bike and what needs attention")
form = Form("repairIntake", btns, [modelField, typeField, symptomsField, serviceField, notesField, approvalField])
modelField = FormControl("Bike Make & Model", Input("bikeModel", "e.g. Trek Domane SL5", "text", { required: true, minLength: 2 }))
typeField = FormControl("Bike Type", Select("bikeType", typeOpts, "Select type...", { required: true }))
typeOpts = [SelectItem("road", "Road"), SelectItem("mountain", "Mountain"), SelectItem("hybrid", "Hybrid"), SelectItem("ebike", "E-Bike"), SelectItem("kids", "Kids")]
symptomsField = FormControl("Reported Symptoms", symptomChips, "Select all that apply")
symptomChips = Chips("symptoms", "multiple", [s1, s2, s3, s4, s5, s6])
s1 = ChipItem("brakes", "Squeaky/weak brakes")
s2 = ChipItem("shifting", "Skipping gears")
s3 = ChipItem("flat", "Flat tire")
s4 = ChipItem("chain", "Noisy chain")
s5 = ChipItem("wobble", "Wheel wobble")
s6 = ChipItem("steering", "Loose steering")
serviceField = FormControl("Service Option", serviceCards, "Choose a service level")
serviceCards = OptionCards("service", "single", [o1, o2, o3], { required: true })
o1 = OptionCard("basic", "Basic Tune-Up", "Brake and gear adjustment, tire inflation", i1)
i1 = Icon("wrench", "tools")
o2 = OptionCard("full", "Full Overhaul", "Deep clean, lube, true wheels, full inspection", i2)
i2 = Icon("settings", "tools")
o3 = OptionCard("repair", "Repair Only", "Fix only the reported symptoms", i3)
i3 = Icon("circle-check", "tools")
notesField = FormControl("Additional Notes", TextArea("notes", "Anything else we should know?", 4))
approvalField = FormControl("Estimate Approval", approvalBox)
approvalBox = CheckBoxGroup("approval", [approveItem], { required: true })
approveItem = CheckBoxItem("I approve an estimate before work begins", "We will contact you with a quote and wait for your OK", "approveEstimate", false)
btns = Buttons([Button("Submit Intake", @ToAssistant("Submit bicycle repair intake"), "primary"), Button("Clear", @ToAssistant("Clear intake form"), "secondary")])
request: Add an optional brake adjustment service and a field for the owner's preferred collection date.
